channels.title: Blackwell Ops
channels.blurb: First-time Windows installer (x64, NVIDIA CUDA). Includes the app and EDGE engine — the setup wizard pulls the CUDA runtime automatically. All future app updates, engine packs, and toolchains install in 1 click inside the app.

channels.title: Blackwell Ops — App Updates (in-app)
channels.blurb: In-app update channel — downloaded automatically by Blackwell Ops (1-click in-app update). First-time users: download the Latest installer instead.

channels.title: Blackwell Ops — Engine Packs (in-app)
channels.blurb: In-app engine pack channel (per provider/profile CUDA builds). Downloaded automatically by Blackwell Ops — manual download is not needed.

channels.title: Blackwell Ops — Toolchain Packs (in-app)
channels.blurb: In-app CUDA runtimes and Foundry build tools. Downloaded automatically by the setup wizard and Foundry — manual download is not needed.

channels.title: OYM Link (internal alpha)
channels.blurb: Internal alpha remote servicing client — self-updates automatically via channel.json. Not a public Blackwell Ops download.
